note: Every value is synthetic. In production each field is entered by an admin or operator, or created by the system. Field names match the code (src/db/schema).

formatting.money: Stored as integer Toman (bigint, e.g. offer_sku.priceToman). Displayed with toLocaleString("fa-IR") + " تومان" — Persian digits, Persian thousands separator (U+066C). Never Rial in the UI.
formatting.date: Stored as ISO/UTC. Displayed in the Persian (Jalali) calendar via Intl fa-IR, Asia/Tehran.
formatting.identifiers: Latin, left-to-right, isolated with <bdi>/.hz-ltr. Alphabet 23456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTUVWXYZ (no 0/O/1/I/L) so codes read aloud or typed from paper cannot collide.
formatting.phone: Synthetic numbers use the reserved 0999 prefix so they can never reach a real person.
formatting.nationalId: Synthetic national ids start at 9000000000, outside the issued range.
formatting.images: One uploaded image per record (imageFileId + mandatory imageAltFa). The same image is shown in several frames, so every image needs a safe area. See images.json.
